content_sections.heading: DGQA Technician Vacancy 2026 – Establishment-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The 14 DGQA Technician vacancies are spread across six establishment codes under different Controllerates/Quality Assurance Establishments. Category-wise distribution as per the notification is shown below. Establishment codes correspond to: SC-009 and SC-009/1 – DGQA Complex, Manovikas Nagar PO, Secunderabad; BLR-006 – Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Radar), JC Nagar PO, Bengaluru; BLR-046 – Senior Quality Assurance Establishment (Electronics), S K Garden, Benson Town PO, Bengaluru; JBP-011 – Senior Quality Assurance Establishment (Electronics), Gun Factory PO, Jabalpur; CHD-002 – Senior Quality Assurance Establishment (Elect & Sys), C/o Ordnance Factory, Chandigarh. Selected candidates are appointed on probation for two years and are liable to serve anywhere within India, including field/remote locations, as per organisational requirement.

content_sections.heading: DGQA Technician Eligibility & Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The essential qualification differs for the two posts: Candidates possessing any additional qualification, or pursuing one, as on the application closing date must mention it in the application form.

rows.essential_qualification: (i) Matriculation (10th class pass) from a recognized Board or equivalent; AND (ii) ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade, or an equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course approved by the Central or State Government; AND one year of experience in the specified trade from a recognized organization or undertaking
ITI pass in any Trade, or its equivalent Defence Services Tradesman course approved by the Central or State Government

content_sections.heading: DGQA Technician Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 18 and 27 years of age as on the application closing date. Date of birth must be as per the 10th/Matriculation certificate or a Birth Certificate issued by a competent authority - Aadhaar Card is not accepted as proof of date of birth. Age relaxation for a reserved category will remain provisional until the appointing authority verifies the supporting documents. SC/ST/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates must enclose the latest Caste/relevant certificate from a competent authority (District Magistrate and equivalent, Chief/Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, or a Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank/Sub-Divisional Officer of the candidate's area). Central Government civilian employees claiming age relaxation must submit a certificate (Annexure-I) from their office confirming at least 3 years of continuous service as on the closing date. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: DGQA Technician Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Recruited candidates will draw pay as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix: Technician (Semi Skilled): Pay Matrix Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 – 56,900) Technician (Skilled): Pay Matrix Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200) In addition to basic pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, Children Education Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, medical facilities, CSD facilities, and other allowances/advances as per extant Government of India rules. Recruited candidates will be covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS)/Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as applicable.

content_sections.heading: DGQA Technician Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: No separate application fee is mentioned in the notification. However, every applicant must submit one self-addressed envelope (size 30cm x 12cm) affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/- along with the application, for despatch of the admit card. The organisation will not be responsible for non-receipt of the admit card due to an incorrect or incomplete address on this envelope.

content_sections.heading: DGQA Technician Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is done through a Written Test followed by a Trade Test - there is no interview . Written Test: Objective type, Multiple Choice Questions only; no negative marking for wrong answers; duration 90 minutes; 100 questions for 100 marks. Question papers for Parts (i), (ii), and (iv) are set in English and Hindi; Part (iii) is in English only. Candidates are shortlisted for the Trade Test based on written test marks and category of reservation. The Trade Test carries 100 marks, with a minimum qualifying mark of 40. The final merit list is prepared post both tests, based on Trade and Establishment. In case of a tie, resolution is by (1) older date of birth ranked higher, then (2) higher marks in Numerical Aptitude, then Reasoning, then General Awareness.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026 has no apply-online option. The application must be sent physically by Registered or Speed Post only. Fill the application in the prescribed format (Appendix 'A'), typed in English on A4 size paper. Attach the Admit Card in the prescribed format - Appendix 'B' for Technician (Semi Skilled) or Appendix 'C' for Technician (Skilled) - submitted in duplicate. Affix one self-attested passport-size photo on the application form, and one self-attested photo on each of the two admit card copies (three photos total). Enclose a self-addressed envelope (30cm x 12cm) affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/- for admit card despatch. Clearly superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Technician (Semi Skilled) / Technician (Skilled)] AND CATEGORY [SC/ST/OBC/UR]". Candidates already working in Government Service or a Public Sector Undertaking must route their application through proper channel, with a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office; applications without this NOC are summarily rejected without further communication. Send the complete application by Registered/Speed Post to: Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Systems), DGQA Technical Complex, Manovikas Nagar P.O., Secunderabad – 500009. Applications received after the closing date, even due to postal delay, are rejected summarily and no correspondence is entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Direct Recruitment drive by the Directorate General of Quality Assurance, Ministry of Defence, for 14 Technician (Skilled and Semi Skilled) Group 'C' Industrial posts across establishments in Secunderabad, Bengaluru, Jabalpur, and Chandigarh (Advt. No. CQA(S)/2026/Tech(SS) & Tech(SK)).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies in total - 7 for Technician (Skilled) and 7 for Technician (Semi Skilled), distributed across six establishment codes.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for DGQA Technician posts?
faq.answer: Technician (Skilled) requires Matriculation plus an ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade (or equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course) with one year of relevant trade experience. Technician (Semi Skilled) requires an ITI pass in any trade, or an equivalent Defence Services Tradesman course.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 18 to 27 years old as on the application closing date, with age relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, Ex-Servicemen, and Departmental candidates as per the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No separate application fee is mentioned. A self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 55/- postal stamp must accompany the application for the admit card.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply online for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. There is no online application process. The application must be sent physically by Registered or Speed Post to the Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Systems), Secunderabad.

faq.question: Q7. hat is the last date to apply for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News (8–14 August 2026 issue), or 28 days for candidates from specified northeastern states, Ladakh, Lahaul & Spiti, Pangi (HP), Andaman & Nicobar Islands, and Lakshadweep. An exact calendar date is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Written Test (100 objective-type questions covering Reasoning, General Awareness, English, and Numerical Aptitude) followed by a Trade Test (100 marks, minimum qualifying marks 40). There is no interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for DGQA Technician posts?
faq.answer: Technician (Semi Skilled) draws pay at Level-1 (Rs. 18,000–56,900) and Technician (Skilled) at Level-2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200) of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, plus DA, HRA, and other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q10. Where will selected DGQA Technician candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are appointed on two years' probation and are liable to serve anywhere in India, including field/remote areas, with initial posting stations at Secunderabad (Telangana), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Jabalpur (Madhya Pradesh), and Chandigarh.
